findings.title: Important pages lack machine-readable summary metadata (17 page(s))
findings.evidence: 17 of 17 important page(s) (importance >= 60) are missing title or meta description. Sample: https://curl.se/ (no title, no meta description); https://curl.se/docs/features.html (no meta description). AI agents use these signals to determine page relevance without full rendering. [Also: crawlability-render-audit: 20 of 20 pages (100%) are missing a <title> and/or <meta name='description'> (including 17 high-importance page(s)).]

suggested_action.summary: Ensure every important page has a descriptive <title> (10-70 chars) and <meta name='description'> (50-160 chars) capturing the page's core value.

findings.title: Important pages missing agent-actionable structured data (17 page(s))
findings.evidence: 17 important page(s) of types that benefit from structured data have no actionable JSON-LD: 16 Documentation, 1 Homepage. Without structured data, AI agents cannot reliably extract offers, schedules, or entity details. [Also: structured-data-content-audit: Crawled 20 pages; 0/20 contain JSON-LD structured data. AI assistants cannot extract machine-readable facts about this site.]

suggested_action.summary: Add appropriate Schema.org JSON-LD to important pages: Product/Offer on product pages, Event on event pages, Organization/WebSite on the homepage. Focus on pages with highest importance scores first.

findings.title: No canonical tags on any crawled page
findings.evidence: 0 of 20 crawled pages contain a <link rel='canonical'> tag. Without canonicals, duplicate content dilutes AI citation quality.

suggested_action.summary: Add <link rel='canonical'> to every page pointing to its preferred URL.

findings.title: No structured data on 1/1 product/service pages
findings.evidence: 1 of 1 product/service pages contain no JSON-LD. AI cannot extract product details, prices, or specs.

suggested_action.summary: Add Product/Offer/Service JSON-LD to every product and service page.

findings.title: Missing Organization or WebSite schema on homepage
findings.evidence: Homepage (https://curl.se/) has no JSON-LD with an Organization, WebSite, or brand entity type. Found types: none. AI assistants cannot reliably identify and describe this brand.

suggested_action.summary: Add Organization and WebSite JSON-LD to the homepage with name, url, logo, description, and sameAs properties.

findings.title: Homepage has no H1 heading
findings.evidence: Homepage (https://curl.se/) has h1: []. No primary topic signal for crawlers.

suggested_action.summary: Add a single, descriptive H1 to the homepage stating the brand name and value proposition.

findings.title: No sitemap signal detected — bulk agent discovery may be impaired
findings.evidence: No sitemap.xml reference found in robots.txt, crawl metadata, or any of the 20 crawled pages. AI indexing systems rely on sitemaps for efficient bulk content discovery, especially for sites with many pages.

suggested_action.summary: Consider publishing an XML sitemap at /sitemap.xml and referencing it in robots.txt (Sitemap: https://yourdomain.com/sitemap.xml). Include all important pages with <lastmod> dates.

findings.title: Inconsistent organization identity across key page elements (2 variations)
findings.evidence: Disparate identity signals detected vs canonical 'libcurl': contact_h1 ('Commercial Support'). AI search agents cross-reference title, H1, and JSON-LD to ground entity identity.

suggested_action.summary: Align organization name consistently across Title, H1 headings, and JSON-LD schema.

findings.title: Alt text missing on 24/31 images (77%)
findings.evidence: 24 of 31 images across 20 page(s) have empty alt attributes. Image content is invisible to AI crawlers.

suggested_action.summary: Add descriptive alt text to all meaningful images.

proactive_recommendations.title: Add VideoObject JSON-LD to pages featuring video content
proactive_recommendations.rationale: 3 page(s) appear to feature video content based on text signals, but no VideoObject schema was detected. VideoObject markup with transcript or description dramatically increases AI discoverability of multimedia content.

proactive_recommendations.title: Add HowTo structured data to guide and tutorial pages
proactive_recommendations.rationale: 2 page(s) have headings suggesting step-by-step guides, but no HowTo JSON-LD was found. HowTo schema is among the highest-ROI types for 'how do I' AI assistant queries.

proactive_recommendations.title: Complete OpenGraph tags for richer social sharing previews
proactive_recommendations.rationale: 20 of 20 pages (100%) are missing og:title, og:description, or og:image. Complete OpenGraph tags improve how content appears when shared on social media and in AI-powered link previews, driving referral traffic.

methodology_and_limitations.audit_scope: Evaluates technical AI discoverability, content extractability, structured data completeness, and citation readiness based on an observable crawl snapshot.
methodology_and_limitations.deterministic_scoring: All scoring formulas and journey deductions are 100% deterministic and rule-grounded, measuring concrete technical readiness rather than subjective or volatile LLM search rankings.
methodology_and_limitations.read_only_guarantee: This audit operates purely in read-only analysis mode without modifying site infrastructure, publishing changes, or executing non-idempotent operations.
limitations: Crawl depth is capped at 20 pages per run under standard execution parameters.
Dynamic Single-Page Application (SPA) content requires headless rendering with Playwright fallback when JavaScript rendering is enabled.
Content behind authentication, paywalls, or strict CAPTCHA barriers is outside audit scope.
